method: Post-draft self-review against reproduced failure, synthetic and paired refit checks, source diff, and independent source/public-surface reviews
score_reason: Concrete implementation and verification statements; pending checks and scope remain explicit.
evidence_none_reason: Concrete results and explicit limits throughout; no stylistic repair required.
science_gate_reason: Consistent-name equivalence distinguished from recovery and interval calibration.
facts_gate_reason: Published technical counts and source changes checked; data outcomes excluded and final remote CI explicitly pending.
references_gate_reason: Issue number and file paths verified; no literature citations.
calibration_status: Protocol calibration examples seen; no benchmark comparison performed
